sections.summary: Opens with a $150M-per-year app claim and promises to show how to build a similar app from scratch with no coding using one AI tool.
Frames why subscription apps beat one-time digital products like ebooks and PDFs, and shares his background of $30M in digital product sales and a $500K/month AI software business.
Sponsor read for Base 44 with a 30% discount available through the first link in the description.

Walks through building a MyFitnessPal-style calorie tracking app in Base 44 from a single prompt, then iterates with prompts to add a landing page, raise the pricing tier, and add a paywall and Stripe-ready subscription gate.

Zooms out to other subscription niches the same process could target (workout, habit, meditation, meal planning, finance) and contrasts the four-prompt build against his own months-long developer-hired build.
Walks step-by-step through signing up for Base 44 via his affiliate link to claim the discount and a free $497 masterclass, plus a VIP ticket to a live AI master class with student case studies.
Returns to the MyFitnessPal framing and closes with a motivational message that the difference is the decision to start now.
